title: ProgramRoomBlockDocument
description: Server-owned reserved room inventory at a programHotels doc — a labelled block of rooms held for a stay window, optionally earmarked for guest groups. Stays consume capacity through roomBlockId; assignedCount is the server-maintained rollup.

hotelId.description: programHotels doc this block reserves rooms at; must belong to the same program.

label.description: Organizer-facing block name, e.g. 'Bride family — Deluxe'.

roomType.description: Optional hotel room class (Deluxe, Suite). Null when the block is type-agnostic.

assignedCount.description: Server-maintained count of live programStays rows bound to this block; never written by clients.

heldForGroupIds.description: programGuestGroups this block is earmarked for; allocation prefers matching groups before general inventory.

startsAt.description: First night of the stay window this block covers.

endsAt.description: Checkout day of the stay window this block covers.

notes.description: Operational notes visible to organizer and hotel desk (rate contact, holding conditions).
